blocks.rationale: Create a reusable airline calculator that separates factual bag measurements from the matched route-and-cabin fee schedule. It deterministically classifies cabin items, applies checked-bag ordinal fees, and uses the higher applicable overweight or oversize surcharge.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the permitted personal-item and carry-on counts and their per-axis limits before treating remaining bags as checked bags.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Use the published base checked-bag rates matching the current travel route, cabin, and checked-bag ordinal.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Determine checked-bag size by adding length, width, and height.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher applicable excess surcharge to its checked-bag fee.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

blocks.rationale: Provide an alternative component-based representation that asks the reader to keep base, overweight, and oversize charges separate for each listed bag. The helper performs the legally material higher-fee comparison and final aggregation itself.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: bag_base_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what base checked-bag fee applies after cabin classification, route-and-cabin ordinal pricing, and complimentary treatment, using 0 for a free cabin item?

inputs.name: bag_overweight_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what overweight surcharge applies under the current cabin weight limit and route schedule, using 0 when none applies?

inputs.name: bag_oversize_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what oversize surcharge applies to its summed outside dimensions under the current route schedule, using 0 when none applies?

skill.intent: Calculate the exact ticket-plus-fees total from separately itemized base, overweight, and oversize charges for every current bag.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all current base and excess baggage fees.
outputs.name: answer

fields.question: What overweight surcharge belongs to each listed bag, with zero when the current weight limit is not exceeded?

fields.name: bag_oversize_fees

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each bag, add the greater of its overweight and oversize components to its base checked-bag fee, then add all bag fees to the ticket.
